      ‖deningerMomentLp r (deningerAdiabaticSource a h - h)‖ +
        ‖deningerMomentLp (r + 1) (deningerAdiabaticSource a h - h)‖ +

  rw [L1.dist_eq_integral_dist]
  have hleft : Integrable
      (fun x : ℝ => dist ((deningerAdiabaticMomentLp ha0 r h) x)
        ((deningerMomentLp r h) x))
      (volume.restrict (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ))) :=
    by
      simpa only [dist_eq_norm, Pi.sub_apply] using
        ((L1.integrable_coeFn (deningerAdiabaticMomentLp ha0 r h)).sub
          (L1.integrable_coeFn (deningerMomentLp r h))).norm
  have hq0 : Integrable
      (deningerMomentFun r (deningerAdiabaticSource a h - h))
      (volume.restrict (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ))) :=
    memLp_one_iff_integrable.mp
      (deningerMomentFun_memLp r (deningerAdiabaticSource a h - h))
  have hq1 : Integrable
      (deningerMomentFun (r + 1) (deningerAdiabaticSource a h - h))
      (volume.restrict (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ))) :=
    memLp_one_iff_integrable.mp
      (deningerMomentFun_memLp (r + 1) (deningerAdiabaticSource a h - h))
  have hb : Integrable (deningerAdiabaticBoundaryError a r h)
      (volume.restrict (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ))) := by
    refine Integrable.mono'
      (deningerAdiabaticBoundaryMajorant_integrable r h)
      (deningerAdiabaticBoundaryError_aestronglyMeasurable a r h) ?_
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with x hx
    exact deningerAdiabaticBoundaryError_norm_le ha0 ha1 r h hx
  have hright : Integrable
      (fun x : ℝ => ‖deningerMomentFun r (deningerAdiabaticSource a h - h) x‖ +
        ‖deningerMomentFun (r + 1) (deningerAdiabaticSource a h - h) x‖ +
        ‖deningerAdiabaticBoundaryError a r h x‖)
      (volume.restrict (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ))) :=
    (hq0.norm.add hq1.norm).add hb.norm
  have hmono := integral_mono_ae hleft hright (by
    filter_upwards [
      MemLp.coeFn_toLp (deningerAdiabaticMomentFun_memLp ha0 r h),
      MemLp.coeFn_toLp (deningerMomentFun_memLp r h),
      ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with x hxa hx0 hx
    change dist
      (((deningerAdiabaticMomentFun_memLp ha0 r h).toLp
        (deningerAdiabaticMomentFun a r h)) x)
      (((deningerMomentFun_memLp r h).toLp (deningerMomentFun r h)) x) ≤ _
    rw [hxa, hx0]
    simpa only [dist_eq_norm] using
      deningerAdiabaticMoment_difference_norm_le ha0 ha1 r h hx)
  refine hmono.trans_eq ?_
  calc
    (∫ x in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ),
        (‖deningerMomentFun r (deningerAdiabaticSource a h - h) x‖ +
          ‖deningerMomentFun (r + 1) (deningerAdiabaticSource a h - h) x‖) +
          ‖deningerAdiabaticBoundaryError a r h x‖) =
        (∫ x in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ),
          ‖deningerMomentFun r (deningerAdiabaticSource a h - h) x‖ +
            ‖deningerMomentFun (r + 1) (deningerAdiabaticSource a h - h) x‖) +
          ∫ x in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), ‖deningerAdiabaticBoundaryError a r h x‖ := by
            exact integral_add (hq0.norm.add hq1.norm) hb.norm
    _ = ((∫ x in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ),
          ‖deningerMomentFun r (deningerAdiabaticSource a h - h) x‖) +
        (∫ x in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ),
          ‖deningerMomentFun (r + 1) (deningerAdiabaticSource a h - h) x‖)) +
        ∫ x in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), ‖deningerAdiabaticBoundaryError a r h x‖ := by
          rw [integral_add hq0.norm hq1.norm]
    _ = _ := by
      rw [← deningerMomentLp_norm r (deningerAdiabaticSource a h - h),
        ← deningerMomentLp_norm (r + 1) (deningerAdiabaticSource a h - h)]

source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  rcases p with _ | q
  · simp
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hpartial⟩ :=
    exists_abs_deningerHarmonicPartial_le_const_div_log_pow (q + 2) (by omega)
  rw [eventually_atTop] at hpartial
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := hpartial
  have hevent : ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop, Real.exp 1 ≤ (N : ℝ) :=
    tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop (Real.exp 1)
  rw [eventually_atTop] at hevent
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := hevent
  let M := max (max K L) 1
  have hMK : K ≤ M := le_trans (le_max_left K L) (le_max_left _ 1)
  have hML : L ≤ M := le_trans (le_max_right K L) (le_max_left _ 1)
  have hM1 : 1 ≤ M := le_max_right _ 1
  have hMe : Real.exp 1 ≤ (M : ℝ) := hL M hML
  let D : ℝ := ((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * 2 ^ q * C
  have hbase : Summable fun n : ℕ =>
      D * (1 / ((n : ℝ) * Real.log (n : ℝ) ^ 2)) :=
    RHTower.burnolSummable_one_div_mul_log_sq.mul_left D
  have hmajor : Summable fun i : ℕ =>
      D / (((i + (M + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) *
        Real.log ((i + (M + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
    have hshift := (summable_nat_add_iff (M + 1)).mpr hbase
    simpa [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_assoc] using hshift
  have hshift : Summable fun i : ℕ =>
      RHTower.deningerHarmonicPartial (i + (M + 1)) *
        (Real.log (((i + (M + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) ^ (q + 1) -
          Real.log ((i + (M + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (q + 1)) := by
    refine Summable.of_norm_bounded hmajor fun i => ?_
    let n := i + (M + 1)
    have hnM : M ≤ n := by dsimp [n]; omega
    have hnK : K ≤ n := hMK.trans hnM
    have hne : Real.exp 1 ≤ (n : ℝ) := hMe.trans (by exact_mod_cast hnM)
    have hn1 : 1 ≤ n := hM1.trans hnM
    have hn0 : (0 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) := by positivity
    have hlog : 1 ≤ Real.log (n : ℝ) := by
      rw [← Real.log_exp 1]
      exact Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos 1) hne
    have hlogpos : 0 < Real.log (n : ℝ) := zero_lt_one.trans_le hlog
    have hpart := hK n hnK
    have hdiff0 : 0 ≤ Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 1) - Real.log (n : ℝ) := by
      exact sub_nonneg.mpr (Real.log_le_log (by positivity) (by linarith))
    have hdiff := log_natCast_succ_sub_log_natCast_le_inv n hn1
    have hlogSucc0 : 0 ≤ Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 1) :=
      Real.log_nonneg (by linarith)
    have hlogSucc : Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 1) ≤ 2 * Real.log (n : ℝ) := by
      have hinc : Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 1) ≤ Real.log (n : ℝ) + 1 / (n : ℝ) := by
        linarith
      have hinv : 1 / (n : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (n : ℝ) := by
        have hinvOne : 1 / (n : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by
          rw [div_le_one hn0]
          exact_mod_cast hn1
        exact hinvOne.trans hlog
      linarith
    have hxAbs : |Real.log (n : ℝ)| ≤ 2 * Real.log (n : ℝ) := by
      rw [abs_of_nonneg hlogpos.le]
      linarith
    have hyAbs : |Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 1)| ≤ 2 * Real.log (n : ℝ) := by
      rw [abs_of_nonneg hlogSucc0]
      exact hlogSucc
    have hpowDiff := GaloisForLFunctions.RHTower.Matveev.abs_pow_sub_pow_le
      hyAbs hxAbs (q + 1)
    have hdiffAbs : |Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 1) - Real.log (n : ℝ)| ≤
        1 / (n : ℝ) := by
      rw [abs_of_nonneg hdiff0]
      exact hdiff
    have hpowDiff' :
        |Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ (q + 1) - Real.log (n : ℝ) ^ (q + 1)| ≤
          ((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 * Real.log (n : ℝ)) ^ q *
            (1 / (n : ℝ)) := by
      exact hpowDiff.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdiffAbs (by positivity))
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul]
    calc
      |RHTower.deningerHarmonicPartial n| *
          |Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ (q + 1) - Real.log (n : ℝ) ^ (q + 1)| ≤
          (C / Real.log (n : ℝ) ^ (q + 2)) *
            (((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 * Real.log (n : ℝ)) ^ q *
              (1 / (n : ℝ))) :=
        mul_le_mul hpart hpowDiff' (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
      _ = D / ((n : ℝ) * Real.log (n : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
        dsimp [D]
        rw [mul_pow, pow_add]
        field_simp [hlogpos.ne', hn0.ne']
      _ = D / (((i + (M + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) *
          Real.log ((i + (M + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2) := by rfl
  exact (summable_nat_add_iff (M + 1)).mp (by
    simpa only [Nat.add_comm] using hshift)

theorem norm_deriv_inghamMollifiedError_four_le
    {X : ℕ} (hX : 1 ≤ X) (t : ℝ) :
    ‖deriv (fun z : ℂ => riemannZeta z * inghamMollifier X z - 1)
        ((4 : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * I)‖ ≤ (X : ℝ) ^ (-1 : ℝ)
source_arguments.source_statement:
theorem norm_deriv_inghamMollifiedError_four_le
    {X : ℕ} (hX : 1 ≤ X) (t : ℝ) :
    ‖deriv (fun z : ℂ => riemannZeta z * inghamMollifier X z - 1)
        ((4 : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * I)‖ ≤ (X : ℝ) ^ (-1 : ℝ)
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  let s : ℂ := (4 : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * I
  let coeff : ℕ → ℂ := complexCoeff (moebiusZetaDefect X)
  let raw : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => riemannZeta z * inghamMollifier X z - 1
  have hsumNorm := summable_norm_complexCoeff_moebiusZetaDefect_damped hX
    (show (1 : ℝ) < 3 / 2 by norm_num)
  have hsum : LSeriesSummable coeff ((3 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    rw [LSeriesSummable, ← summable_norm_iff]
    apply hsumNorm.congr
    intro n
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
    · simp [LSeries.term_def]
    · have hnR : (0 : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn
      rw [LSeries.norm_term_eq, if_neg hn.ne']
      simp only [Complex.ofReal_re]
      rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real,
        Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg hnR.le _)]
      dsimp only [coeff]
      rw [Real.rpow_neg hnR.le]
      exact (div_eq_mul_inv _ _).symm
  have habs : LSeries.abscissaOfAbsConv coeff < s.re := by
    refine hsum.abscissaOfAbsConv_le.trans_lt ?_
    norm_num [s]
  have hopen : {z : ℂ | 1 < z.re} ∈ nhds s :=
    (isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_re).mem_nhds (by simp [s])
  have heq : raw =ᶠ[nhds s] fun z => -LSeries coeff z := by
    filter_upwards [hopen] with z hz
    dsimp only [raw, coeff]
    rw [LSeries_complexCoeff_moebiusZetaDefect_eq X hz]
    ring
  have hL := LSeries_hasDerivAt habs
  calc
    ‖deriv raw s‖ =
        ‖LSeries (LSeries.logMul coeff) s‖ := by
      rw [heq.deriv_eq]
      change ‖deriv (-LSeries coeff) s‖ = _
      rw [hL.neg.deriv]
      simp
    _ ≤ (X : ℝ) ^ (-1 : ℝ) := by
      simpa only [s, coeff] using
        norm_LSeries_logMul_moebiusZetaDefect_four_le hX t

import GaloisForLFunctions.RHTower.DeningerAbelMajorant

/-!
# The canonical Möbius preimage has finite mass on the ray

The Abel identity presents the preimage as a limit of partial sums whose norms are uniformly
bounded by the majorant, so the preimage itself is bounded by the majorant pointwise.  Since the
majorant has finite total mass, so does the preimage:

`∫_0^∞ |f_h(x)| dx < ∞`.

No integrability of `f_h` is assumed anywhere — the estimate is proved in `ℝ≥0∞`, where the
comparison needs nothing but the pointwise bound.

* `deningerMobiusPreimage_enorm_le` : the preimage is bounded by the majorant.
* `deningerMobiusPreimage_mass_lt_top` : **the preimage has finite mass on the ray.**
-/

namespace RHTower

open MeasureTheory SchwartzMap ENNReal Filter Topology

noncomputable section

/-- **The preimage is bounded by the majorant.**  The Abel partial sums are uniformly bounded by
the majorant, and the enorm is continuous. -/
theorem deningerMobiusPreimage_enorm_le {h : 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ)} (hh : h ∈ DeningerExpSchwartz) {x : ℝ}
    (hx : 0 < x) :
    ‖deningerMobiusPreimage h x‖ₑ ≤ deningerAbelMajorant h x := by
  have habel := deningerMobius_abel hh hx
  have hcont : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ‖∑ i ∈ Finset.range n,
      (deningerLogPull h (((i : ℝ) + 1) * x) - deningerLogPull h ((i : ℝ) * x)) *
        ((Sieve.mertensM i : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ₑ) atTop
      (𝓝 ‖-deningerMobiusPreimage h x‖ₑ) :=
    ((continuous_enorm.tendsto _).comp habel)
  have hbound : ∀ n : ℕ, ‖∑ i ∈ Finset.range n,
      (deningerLogPull h (((i : ℝ) + 1) * x) - deningerLogPull h ((i : ℝ) * x)) *
        ((Sieve.mertensM i : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ₑ ≤ deningerAbelMajorant h x := by
    intro n
    refine le_trans (enorm_sum_le _ _) ?_
    have hterm : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range n,
        ‖(deningerLogPull h (((i : ℝ) + 1) * x) - deningerLogPull h ((i : ℝ) * x)) *
          ((Sieve.mertensM i : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ₑ
          = ENNReal.ofReal |Sieve.mertensM i| *
            ‖deningerLogPull h (((i : ℝ) + 1) * x) - deningerLogPull h ((i : ℝ) * x)‖ₑ := by
      intro i _
      rw [enorm_mul, mul_comm]
      congr 1
      rw [← ofReal_norm, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hterm]
    exact ENNReal.sum_le_tsum _
  have hle := le_of_tendsto hcont (Eventually.of_forall hbound)
  rwa [enorm_neg] at hle

/-- **The canonical Möbius preimage has finite mass on the positive ray.**  This is the `L¹` half
of the all-moment domain: the unconditional Möbius saving, Abel summation and the dilation-window
exchange combine to a finite bound. -/
theorem deningerMobiusPreimage_mass_lt_top {h : 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ)} (hh : h ∈ DeningerExpSchwartz) :
    (∫⁻ x in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), ‖deningerMobiusPreimage h x‖ₑ) < ⊤ := by
  refine lt_of_le_of_lt ?_ (deningerAbelMajorant_mass_lt_top hh)
  refine setLIntegral_mono' measurableSet_Ioi fun x hx => ?_
  exact deningerMobiusPreimage_enorm_le hh hx

end

end RHTower

import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Group.Tannery

/-!
# Pointwise damping alone cannot dominate differentiated tails

Abe's point-separation argument uses pointwise strict damping together with a
parameter-independent summable majorant, so Tannery's theorem handles the
undifferentiated complement sum.  At positive jet order, differentiating the
damping exponential produces powers of the parameter.  A strict negative
phase that may approach zero cannot absorb even the first such power uniformly.

The first theorem records the valid value-level Tannery step.  The second is a
closed obstruction to extending it to derivatives from strict pointwise phase
negativity alone.
-/

open Filter Topology

namespace GaloisForLFunctions.HTGeometry

/-- **Abe's valid value-level tail principle.** Pointwise damping plus a single
parameter-independent summable majorant makes the whole complement `tsum` vanish; no uniform
negative phase gap is needed. -/
theorem tendsto_tsum_zero_of_pointwise_damping_of_summable_majorant
    {T ι : Type*} {l : Filter T} {f : T → ι → ℂ} {bound : ι → ℝ}
    (hbound : Summable bound)
    (hpoint : ∀ z : ι, Tendsto (fun t => f t z) l (nhds 0))
    (hdom : ∀ᶠ t in l, ∀ z : ι, ‖f t z‖ ≤ bound z) :
    Tendsto (fun t => ∑' z : ι, f t z) l (nhds 0) := by
  simpa using tendsto_tsum_of_dominated_convergence hbound hpoint hdom

/-- **No common dominator for the first damping derivative.**  Strict pointwise decay
`exp (-a B)` with arbitrary `a > 0` does not uniformly absorb its derivative factor `B`.
Consequently, a derivative-stable summable dominator needs additional quantitative structure;
strict phase negativity by itself is insufficient. -/
theorem not_exists_uniform_linear_exponential_damping_bound :
    ¬ ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ B a : ℝ, 0 ≤ B → 0 < a →
      B * Real.exp (-a * B) ≤ C := by
  rintro ⟨C, hC⟩
  have hC0 : 0 ≤ C := by
    have h := hC 1 1 zero_le_one zero_lt_one
    norm_num at h ⊢
    exact (Real.exp_pos (-1)).le.trans h
  let B : ℝ := (C + 1) * Real.exp 1
  have hBpos : 0 < B := by
    dsimp [B]
    positivity
  have ha : 0 < B⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr hBpos
  have h := hC B B⁻¹ hBpos.le ha
  have hunit : B⁻¹ * B = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ hBpos.ne'
  have hvalue : B * Real.exp (-(B⁻¹) * B) = C + 1 := by
    rw [show -B⁻¹ * B = -(B⁻¹ * B) by ring]
    rw [hunit]
    dsimp [B]
    rw [Real.exp_neg]
    field_simp
  rw [hvalue] at h
  linarith

end GaloisForLFunctions.HTGeometry

import GaloisForLFunctions.RHTower.DeningerPreimageMass

/-!
# All moments of the canonical Möbius preimage are finite

The canonical preimage is bounded pointwise by the Abel majorant, so its `x^r`-weighted mass is
bounded by the mass of the order-`r` majorant, which is finite for every `r ≥ 1`.  Together with
the order-`0` bound this gives

`∫_0^∞ x^r |f_h(x)| dx < ∞` for every `r ≥ 0`,

so the canonical preimage lies in every weighted `L¹` of the ray: all its moments exist.

* `deningerMobiusPreimage_aestronglyMeasurable` : the preimage is measurable on the ray.
* `deningerMobiusPreimage_higherMass_lt_top` : **every weighted mass is finite.**
* `deningerMobiusPreimage_moment_integrable` : **every moment of the preimage exists.**
-/

namespace RHTower

open MeasureTheory SchwartzMap ENNReal Filter Topology ArithmeticFunction

noncomputable section

/-- The Abel partial sums of the Möbius series are measurable. -/
theorem deningerMobiusPartial_measurable (h : 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ)) (N : ℕ) :
    Measurable fun x : ℝ =>
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, ((moebius n : ℤ) : ℂ) * deningerLogPull h ((n : ℝ) * x) := by
  have hpull : Measurable (deningerLogPull h) :=
    (h.continuous.measurable).comp Real.measurable_log
  refine Finset.measurable_sum _ fun n _ => ?_
  exact (hpull.comp (measurable_id.const_mul _)).const_mul _

/-- **The canonical preimage is measurable on the ray.**  It is the pointwise limit of its Abel
partial sums, which converge at every positive point. -/
theorem deningerMobiusPreimage_aestronglyMeasurable {h : 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ)}
    (hh : h ∈ DeningerExpSchwartz) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable (deningerMobiusPreimage h) (volume.restrict (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ))) := by
  refine aestronglyMeasurable_of_tendsto_ae atTop
    (fun N => (deningerMobiusPartial_measurable h N).aestronglyMeasurable) ?_
  filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with x hx
  have hx0 : (0 : ℝ) < x := hx
  exact (deningerMobiusRay_summable hh hx0).hasSum.tendsto_sum_nat

/-- The preimage is bounded by the order-`r` majorant. -/
theorem deningerMobiusPreimage_higherEnorm_le {h : 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ)} (hh : h ∈ DeningerExpSchwartz)
    (r : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    ENNReal.ofReal (x ^ r) * ‖deningerMobiusPreimage h x‖ₑ ≤ deningerHigherMajorant h r x := by
  rw [deningerHigherMajorant]
  exact mul_le_mul_right (deningerMobiusPreimage_enorm_le hh hx) _

/-- **Every weighted mass of the canonical preimage is finite.** -/
theorem deningerMobiusPreimage_higherMass_lt_top {h : 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ)} (hh : h ∈ DeningerExpSchwartz)
    {r : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) :
    (∫⁻ x in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ),
        ENNReal.ofReal (x ^ r) * ‖deningerMobiusPreimage h x‖ₑ) < ⊤ := by
  refine lt_of_le_of_lt ?_ (deningerHigherMajorant_mass_lt_top hh hr)
  refine setLIntegral_mono' measurableSet_Ioi fun x hx => ?_
  exact deningerMobiusPreimage_higherEnorm_le hh r hx

/-- **Every moment of the canonical preimage exists.**  For `r = 0` this is the `L¹` bound; for
`r ≥ 1` it is the order-`r` majorant estimate. -/
theorem deningerMobiusPreimage_moment_integrable {h : 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ)} (hh : h ∈ DeningerExpSchwartz)
    (r : ℕ) :
    IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ => ((x ^ r : ℝ) : ℂ) * deningerMobiusPreimage h x)
      (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)) := by
  have hmeas : AEStronglyMeasurable
      (fun x : ℝ => ((x ^ r : ℝ) : ℂ) * deningerMobiusPreimage h x)
      (volume.restrict (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ))) :=
    ((Complex.measurable_ofReal.comp (measurable_id.pow_const r)).aestronglyMeasurable).mul
      (deningerMobiusPreimage_aestronglyMeasurable hh)
  refine ⟨hmeas, ?_⟩
  rw [hasFiniteIntegral_iff_enorm]
  have hcongr : (∫⁻ x in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ),
      ‖((x ^ r : ℝ) : ℂ) * deningerMobiusPreimage h x‖ₑ)
      = ∫⁻ x in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ),
        ENNReal.ofReal (x ^ r) * ‖deningerMobiusPreimage h x‖ₑ := by
    refine setLIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi fun x hx => ?_
    have hx0 : (0 : ℝ) < x := hx
    rw [enorm_mul, ← ofReal_norm, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_nonneg (pow_nonneg hx0.le r)]
  rw [hcongr]
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos r with rfl | hr
  · have h0 : (∫⁻ x in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ),
        ENNReal.ofReal (x ^ (0 : ℕ)) * ‖deningerMobiusPreimage h x‖ₑ)
        = ∫⁻ x in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), ‖deningerMobiusPreimage h x‖ₑ := by
      refine lintegral_congr fun x => ?_
      rw [pow_zero, ENNReal.ofReal_one, one_mul]
    rw [h0]
    exact deningerMobiusPreimage_mass_lt_top hh
  · exact deningerMobiusPreimage_higherMass_lt_top hh hr

end

end RHTower

/-!
# The even extension of the Möbius preimage is integrable on the line

Each weighted moment of the canonical preimage is finite on the positive ray, and reflection
carries that estimate to the negative ray.  The origin is a null set, so the even extension is
integrable on the whole line, together with all its polynomial moments.

This is the `L¹` datum that turns the even extension into a tempered distribution.

* `deningerMobiusPreimage_integrableOn` : the preimage is integrable on the ray.
* `deningerEvenPreimage_moment_integrable` : **every moment of the even extension is finite.**
* `deningerEvenPreimage_integrable` : **the even extension is integrable on the line.**
-/

namespace RHTower

open MeasureTheory SchwartzMap

noncomputable section

/-- The canonical preimage is integrable on the positive ray. -/
theorem deningerMobiusPreimage_integrableOn {h : 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ)} (hh : h ∈ DeningerExpSchwartz) :
    IntegrableOn (deningerMobiusPreimage h) (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)) := by
  have hint := deningerMobiusPreimage_moment_integrable hh 0
  refine hint.congr_fun (fun x _ => ?_) measurableSet_Ioi
  simp

/-- The weighted preimage is integrable on the positive ray, at every order. -/
theorem deningerMobiusPreimagePow_integrableOn {h : 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ)} (hh : h ∈ DeningerExpSchwartz)
    (r : ℕ) :
    IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ => ((x ^ r : ℝ) : ℂ) * deningerMobiusPreimage h x)
      (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)) :=
  deningerMobiusPreimage_moment_integrable hh r

/-- The complement of the origin carries the whole Lebesgue measure. -/
theorem deningerCompl_zero_ae_univ : ({(0 : ℝ)}ᶜ : Set ℝ) =ᵐ[volume] Set.univ :=
  ae_eq_univ.mpr (by simp)

/-- Integrability on both open rays is integrability on the line. -/
theorem deningerIntegrable_of_rays {g : ℝ → ℂ} (hpos : IntegrableOn g (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)))
    (hneg : IntegrableOn g (Set.Iio (0 : ℝ))) : Integrable g := by
  have hunion : IntegrableOn g (Set.Iio (0 : ℝ) ∪ Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)) :=
    integrableOn_union.mpr ⟨hneg, hpos⟩
  rw [Set.Iio_union_Ioi] at hunion
  have huniv : IntegrableOn g Set.univ :=
    hunion.congr_set_ae deningerCompl_zero_ae_univ.symm
  rwa [integrableOn_univ] at huniv

/-- **Every moment of the even extension is integrable on the line.** -/
theorem deningerEvenPreimage_moment_integrable {h : 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ)} (hh : h ∈ DeningerExpSchwartz)
    (r : ℕ) :
    Integrable (fun x : ℝ => ((x ^ r : ℝ) : ℂ) * deningerEvenPreimage h x) := by
  have hpos : IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ => ((x ^ r : ℝ) : ℂ) * deningerEvenPreimage h x)
      (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)) := by
    refine (deningerMobiusPreimagePow_integrableOn hh r).congr_fun (fun x hx => ?_)
      measurableSet_Ioi
    rw [deningerEvenPreimage_of_pos h hx]
  have hrefl : IntegrableOn
      (fun x : ℝ => ((((-x) ^ r : ℝ)) : ℂ) * deningerMobiusPreimage h (-x))
      (Set.Iio (0 : ℝ)) :=
    deningerEvenPreimage_integrableOn_Iio
      (g := fun y : ℝ => ((y ^ r : ℝ) : ℂ) * deningerMobiusPreimage h y)
      (deningerMobiusPreimagePow_integrableOn hh r)
  have hneg : IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ => ((x ^ r : ℝ) : ℂ) * deningerEvenPreimage h x)
      (Set.Iio (0 : ℝ)) := by
    refine IntegrableOn.congr_fun (hrefl.const_mul ((-1 : ℂ) ^ r))
      (fun x hx => ?_) measurableSet_Iio
    have hx0 : x < 0 := hx
    have hsign : ((-1 : ℂ) ^ r) * ((((-x) ^ r : ℝ)) : ℂ) = ((x ^ r : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      have h1 : ((((-x) ^ r : ℝ)) : ℂ) = ((-1 : ℂ) ^ r) * ((x ^ r : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
        push_cast
        rw [neg_pow]
      rw [h1, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_pow]
      norm_num
    rw [deningerEvenPreimage_of_neg h hx0, ← mul_assoc, hsign]
  exact deningerIntegrable_of_rays hpos hneg

/-- **The even extension is integrable on the line.** -/
theorem deningerEvenPreimage_integrable {h : 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ)} (hh : h ∈ DeningerExpSchwartz) :
    Integrable (deningerEvenPreimage h) := by
  have hint := deningerEvenPreimage_moment_integrable hh 0
  refine hint.congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => ?_)
  simp

end
